mapper.sql: SELECT c.channel_id, c.channel_type, c.account_name, c.account_id, c.account_url, c.fans_count, c.user_id, c.channel_status, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, u.nick_name as user_name FROM mk_channel c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_channel (channel_type, account_name, account_id, account_url, fans_count, user_id, channel_status, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{channelType}, #{accountName}, #{accountId}, #{accountUrl}, #{fansCount}, #{userId}, #{channelStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_channel SET del_flag = '2' WHERE channel_id IN #{channelId}
